headline: Amber Enterprises India Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to update the exchange on the Scheme of Amalgamation of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited with and into the Company. In context of hearing held on…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to update the exchange on the Scheme of Amalgamation of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited with and into the Company. In context of hearing held on 25th September 2026, the Company has received an order dated 25th September 2026 received on 1st October 2026, passed by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, in CP(CAA) No. 18/Chd/Pb/2026 connected with CA(CAA) No. 11/Chd/Pb/2026.
